guidance.chooseWhen: Connect an Axios API client to TanStack Query.
features: Query, infinite-query and mutation factories; imperative execute functions.
A shared endpoint factory binds a client.
constraints: Use typed factory definitions rather than inventing URL/data props on visual components.
The application owns authentication, query keys, request types and error UX.
Standard query and mutation functions expose .execute; infinite-query factories return hooks only, without an imperative execute API.
setup: Axios client and TanStack Query QueryClientProvider; install axios and @tanstack/react-query.
